matching_method: Point timestamp falls inclusively within the NOTAM's effective start/end interval.

interpretation.temporal_match: Time overlap only; it does not establish geographic or operational applicability.

limitations: Trajectory points use a preliminary geographic bounding box, not an official Pakistan FIR polygon.
NOTAM location codes alone do not prove a trajectory used the affected runway, airport facility, or airspace.
Database status alone does not establish applicability.
A missing match does not prove a flight was unaffected.
Only NOTAM records stored in this database were examined.
